source: Vattenfall Eldistribution, capacity map of the local networks (indicative MW per supply area)
licence: Vattenfall public web map (no licence stated)
mapping: more than 0 MW within 1-2 years -> available, more than 0 MW only in 2-3 or 3-5 years -> limited, 0 MW -> none
note: Vattenfall publishes one figure per technology (solar, wind, storage and three consumption types) and the years to a possible connection ('1-2', '2-3', '3-5'); mw_gen = wind, mw_load = 'medium' consumption, as published for the earliest horizon each station lists (the horizon is in the name); areas simplified to ~200 m for the map; positions: the middle of each area's bounding box (computed)
